verdict.rationale: Airbyte ships an official MCP server ("Airbyte Agents") letting NL-driven agents like Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT query, search and act on connected data, and an AI Assistant that auto-fills Connector Builder fields, both enabling some natural-language-driven operation. However, these cover specific slices (data querying via MCP, connector setup assist) rather than full natural-language control over core Airbyte operations like creating connections, running/monitoring syncs, or managing schedules. Missing for 10: evidence of NL commands directly operating sync/connection management, independent hands-on verification of the MCP agent experience, and broader coverage beyond connector building and data querying.
